articles.title: No More Screens for Little Kids in LA Schools!
articles.summary: Los Angeles schools just started a big new rule: first graders and younger get zero screen time. Teachers are trying to figure out how to teach without laptops and tablets. Over 400,000 students are affected.

articles.title: UK's Sizzling Summer Set to Smash Heat Records!
articles.summary: This summer in the UK is so hot it's about to break the all-time record. Temperatures hit 38°C in June, and there have been 37 heatwave days in a row. Millions of people face water restrictions because of a drought.

articles.title: Big Soccer Fight Won't Stop the U-20 Women's World Cup!
articles.summary: Poland says the Under-20 Women's World Cup will happen next month, even though some European soccer bosses are boycotting FIFA events. Teams from France and New Zealand have already said they'll play. The tournament is a huge deal for young players.
